title: Church Leadership
definition: Church Leadership is the Christ-accountable service of qualified leaders who shepherd, teach, guard, and equip God’s people according to Scripture.
summary: Church Leadership is the Christ-accountable service of qualified leaders who shepherd, teach, guard, and equip God’s people according to Scripture.
christFocus: Jesus is the chief Shepherd and head of the Church, and all faithful leaders serve under His authority for the good of His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church leadership exists for service, not control. Scripture gives leaders to shepherd the flock, teach sound doctrine, guard against error, care for souls, and equip the saints for ministry.

Leadership in the Church must be shaped by character before platform. God cares about humility, faithfulness, holiness, self-control, hospitality, sound teaching, and love for people more than charisma or popularity.

All church leaders answer to Christ. They do not own the Church; they serve the people Jesus purchased with His blood.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people have been wounded by leaders who used authority for pride, pressure, or self-protection. Scripture restores leadership to its Christlike purpose: humble shepherding under the Chief Shepherd.

This doctrine also helps believers honor faithful leaders without making them untouchable. Leaders are gifts, but Christ alone is Lord.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for church leaders and evaluate leadership by Scripture. If you lead, serve as one accountable to Christ. If you follow, do so with discernment, humility, and confidence that Jesus is the true Shepherd of His people.
